subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do maintainers accept the new pinned executable code for the token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, Blacksmith, and Codex actions after exact-head validation and direct Codex contract inspection?
rationale: These actions execute with credentials or affect security and release automation, so supply-chain acceptance and the Codex runtime boundary require explicit owner judgment beyond a syntactically correct diff.

options.title: Validate and merge together
options.body: Rebase, finish the security and workflow checks, inspect the Codex contract, and merge the grouped immutable pins.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-generation, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates for narrower validation and rollback.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause the update if the sensitive action contracts cannot be verified confidently.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge together
recommendation.body: Rebase, finish the security and workflow checks, inspect the Codex contract, and merge the grouped immutable pins.
